description: Charm (littensy/charm) reactive state used with Vide UI - Charm signals and computed values as game state, the vide-charm bridge (useSignalState), selectors, immutable table updates, and CharmSync server-to-client data. Load it together with the roblox-dev:vide skill whenever Vide UI reads or writes Charm state; when adding a Charm signal, computed, or store module that UI will display; when wiring CharmSync data into UI; and when a Vide label stops updating after a Charm signal changes.

results.query: My coins label never updates after I call setCoins on our Charm signal. It's a Vide component: Text = function() return `Coins: {CoinStore.getCoins()}` end. What's wrong?
How do I use useSignalState from vide-charm to show the player's inventory count in a Vide component?
We sync player data to clients with CharmSync. How do I hook the client's synced gems signal into my Vide HUD so the gems label updates?
Add a Charm computed for whether the player can afford an item to the Shop module, and gray out the buy button in the Vide shop panel when they can't.
In Studio, adding an item to my Charm inventory signal errors with "attempt to modify a readonly table", and the Vide inventory grid never shows the new item. What am I doing wrong?
Write a Charm store module for quest progress. Our Vide quest tracker panel will display it.
My Vide pet list rebuilds every row whenever any pet changes. The pets are in a Charm signal and I bridge them with useSignalState(function() return table.clone(PetStore.getPets()) end).
Should the open tab of my Vide shop menu be a Charm atom or a Vide source? Nothing outside the menu cares which tab is open, but the coins it shows are in Charm.
I call VideCharm.useSignalState at the top of my LocalScript, before mount, and it errors with "cannot cleanup outside a stable or reactive scope". Why?
Our Vide round timer component calls Charm.subscribe on the round state to play a tick sound. After closing and reopening the HUD the tick plays twice. How do I fix it?
On the server, how do I make a Charm computed that adds up two atoms, coins and gems, and run a function whenever the total changes? There's no UI involved.
Set up CharmSync so the server's round state reaches every client. On the client it only drives the music system, nothing on screen.
My Vide health bar doesn't move when the player takes damage. I read humanoid.Health inside the Size binding. How do I make it update?
How do I connect a Reflex producer to my react-lua inventory screen so it re-renders when the inventory changes?
We're moving our server-side economy from Rodux to Charm. Show me how to turn this coins reducer into Charm signals.
In Fusion 0.3, how do I turn a Value holding coins into a Computed that formats it with thousands separators?
Write a UI Labs story for my Vide CoinLabel component, which takes Coins as a prop, with a slider control for the coin count.
My Charm effect on the server runs about a thousand times a second and the server heartbeat is suffering. How do I find out why?
What's the Charm 0.11 replacement for peek, and does untracked behave the same inside effects? This is for our server combat code.
My Vide inventory screen needs to know which tab is open and which slot is hovered. Where should that state live? It isn't used anywhere else and we don't use any state library.
